# (data/abrs/cache/isa/s_OSD-7.txt): hardware ABRS, light colour white, Variety
# "60% WS, 40% Col-0 WT" for the dissected organs and "WS WT" for whole plants,
# 5 v 5 replicates per organ (3 v 3 for whole plants).
# carbon_pct_earth = 100 for ABRS is an ASSUMPTION: it reuses the vented-class value of
# LunarLeaf-CFD T11. No CFD run of ABRS exists.
# Open decision: data/study_registry.tsv EXCLUDES OSD-7, because Affymetrix log2 fold
# changes are not on the same scale as the GeneLab RNA-seq ones. The ABRS extension
# includes it in the ladder regardless.
